description: Qarera brings your job search into ChatGPT. Search Qarera's job database for roles that fit your experience, save them to a Kanban-style application tracker, and tailor your resume to a specific job with a clear before/after of what changed. Pull up your tracked applications and move them through stages applied, interviewing, offered etc. without leaving the chat. Free to use.
